summary: Gabon's DGDI says the e-Visa application form is completed online, that e-Visas are currently valid only for visits by air via Léon-Mba International Airport in Libreville, and that payment is made on arrival when the e-visa sticker is delivered. The DGDI's list of visa exemptions under bilateral agreements includes ordinary passports of Mauritius, Morocco and South Africa. Gabon's Law No. 5/86 on the admission and stay of foreigners says nationals of States that have not concluded an immigration agreement with Gabon must hold a visa and a return or circular transport ticket to enter, and the UK, Canadian, Australian and French governments say their citizens need a visa.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Gabon?
faq.answer: Unless your country has concluded an immigration agreement with Gabon, yes: Gabon's Law No. 5/86 says nationals of States that have not concluded one must hold a visa and a return or circular transport ticket to enter. The UK, Canadian, Australian and French governments say their citizens need a visa; France says it can be requested on the website of the Directorate General of Documentation and Immigration (DGDI). The DGDI's list of visa exemptions under bilateral agreements includes ordinary passports of Mauritius, Morocco and South Africa. The US State Department says that on 18 December 2025 Gabon's Council of Ministers announced that Gabon would suspend visa issuance to US citizens, in reciprocity with similar restrictions imposed by the United States on 1 January 2026.

faq.question: Can I get a visa on arrival in Gabon?
faq.answer: The DGDI says e-Visa payments are made on arrival at the delivery of the e-visa sticker, that an applicant should not travel without having received the Travel Authorization Receipt, and that e-Visas are currently valid only for visits by air via Léon-Mba International Airport in Libreville.

faq.question: Are US and EU citizens visa-free for Gabon?
faq.answer: France tells its citizens that all travellers must hold a visa, which can be requested on the DGDI website, and the UK, Canada and Australia say their citizens need a visa. The US State Department says that on 18 December 2025 Gabon's Council of Ministers announced that Gabon would suspend visa issuance to US citizens, in reciprocity with similar restrictions imposed by the United States on 1 January 2026. No official source we could read confirms an exemption for EU, Norwegian, Swiss, Icelandic or Liechtenstein citizens.

faq.question: Is yellow fever vaccination required for Gabon?

faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says the currency in Gabon is the African Financial Community (CFA) franc (XAF), that euros and US dollars are widely accepted, though high exchange charges may apply, and that credit cards are accepted only in Libreville's large hotels, restaurants and supermarkets.

levies.name: Redevance de sûreté des passagers (passenger security charge)
levies.exemptions: Passengers in transit or connecting; children under two years of age.
levies.text: Every passenger on a commercial flight departing from a Gabonese airport open to public air traffic where passenger security screening is carried out owes the security charge. The airline or aircraft operator collects it from passengers when the ticket is issued: 6,000 CFA francs on the domestic network, 16,000 CFA francs on the CEMAC regional network and 22,000 CFA francs on the international network. Passengers in transit or connecting and children under two are exempt. The order takes effect from the date it was signed.
